title: SHG List Assam: Check Your Name at nrlm.gov.in
meta_description: Check the Assam SHG list at nrlm.gov.in to confirm your group and unlock MMUA seed money (Rs 10,000) and Lakhpati Baideo support under ASRLM.

hero.one_liner: The Assam SHG list at nrlm.gov.in confirms whether your self-help group is registered under ASRLM. A registered group unlocks MMUA and Lakhpati Baideo benefits.

what_is_it: A self-help group under the NRLM programme is an informal association of 10 to 20 women from the same village or neighbourhood who pool a small fixed savings amount every week or month to create a common fund. The group uses this fund to give internal loans to members at low interest, helping them manage household expenses, invest in small businesses, or meet emergencies without turning to moneylenders.

The National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM), also known as DAY-NRLM (Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana NRLM), is the central government's flagship programme for organising rural women into SHGs and connecting them to financial institutions and livelihood support. NRLM is implemented through state-level missions in each state, and in Assam the implementing body is the Assam State Rural Livelihoods Mission, known as ASRLM.

how_to_apply.title: Open nrlm.gov.in
how_to_apply.description: Open your phone or computer browser and go to nrlm.gov.in, the official National Rural Livelihoods Mission portal maintained by the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. This portal contains the complete database of all SHGs registered under the NRLM programme across every state, including all Assam SHGs enrolled through ASRLM. No login or registration is required to access the public SHG list reports, and the service is completely free of charge.

how_to_apply.title: Go to Reports or SHG List section
how_to_apply.description: On the nrlm.gov.in home page, look for the 'Reports' section, 'Analytical Reports', or a link labelled 'SHG Block Wise Report' in the navigation menu or quick links. Some versions of the portal show the SHG search under a 'Beneficiary Reports' tab. If you cannot find it immediately, scroll down the home page or look for a reports menu in the top navigation bar. You can also search for 'nrlm shg list Assam' in a search engine to find the direct page.

how_to_apply.title: Select Assam as your state
how_to_apply.description: In the reports section, an interactive map of India or a dropdown list of states will appear on the page. Click on or select 'Assam' from the list to load Assam-specific data. The portal will now show options to narrow your search to specific districts within Assam. If an overview count of Assam SHGs appears at this stage, use the filter or drill-down options to go deeper into your specific location.

how_to_apply.title: Select your District, Block, Gram Panchayat, and Village
how_to_apply.description: Choose your district name from the dropdown that appears, then select your block, then your gram panchayat, and finally your village name. Each selection loads a new set of options for the next administrative level. If your village does not appear in the list, it may mean no ASRLM-registered SHG exists in your village yet, in which case you can contact the Block Programme Manager at your block ASRLM office for guidance on forming a new group.

how_to_apply.title: Select your SHG and view the member list
how_to_apply.description: After selecting your village, all SHGs registered in that village will appear in a list. Click on your group's name to open the full member list for that SHG. The list shows each member's name, the SHG Group ID, the group name, the linked bank account details, and other enrollment information. If your name appears here, your group is officially registered under the NRLM programme in Assam and is eligible for scheme benefits.

how_to_apply.title: Note your SHG ID and report errors
how_to_apply.description: Write down your SHG Group ID and the linked savings bank account details shown on the portal. This Group ID is required when applying under MMUA, Lakhpati Baideo, and for bank credit linkage processes. If your group is not listed or your name is missing despite you being an active member, do not wait - contact your block-level ASRLM Community Resource Person (CRP) or the Block Programme Manager as soon as possible. They can initiate a correction request to update the NRLM database with your group's information.

ministry: Assam State Rural Livelihoods Mission (ASRLM), P&RD Department

extra_sections.heading: What the Assam SHG List Is
content: ASRLM was formally constituted to implement the NRLM across all 35 districts of Assam, covering both the rural plains districts and the hill districts. The mission's work involves identifying poor rural households, mobilising women into SHGs, training them on group management and financial literacy, linking them to bank accounts, and connecting them to government welfare schemes and livelihood support.

The NRLM portal at nrlm.gov.in serves as the public-facing database of all SHGs registered under the programme. Every SHG that is formally constituted and registered by an ASRLM Community Resource Person or Block Programme Manager gets its details entered into the NRLM MIS, which is then visible to the public through the SHG list reports section on the portal.

The SHG list on nrlm.gov.in is the single most authoritative source for confirming whether your group is officially enrolled and eligible for government scheme benefits. The list displays the group's name, SHG ID, date of formation, gram panchayat, block, district, member names, savings account details, and grading level, with the grading level determining how much bank credit the group can access.

ASRLM organises SHGs into graded tiers based on maturity and financial discipline, with new groups starting in the 'Panchasutra' stage that covers regular meetings, savings, lending, record-keeping, and repayment before graduating to higher grades. Well-graded SHGs qualify for larger bank loans and have accessed revolving funds and Community Investment Funds provided by ASRLM under the NRLM framework.

extra_sections.heading: The Three MMUA Phases
content: The Assam government runs the Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyamita Abhiyan (MMUA) as a state-funded complement to the central NRLM framework. MMUA provides financial assistance in three progressive phases to active members of ASRLM-registered SHGs, with the goal of helping each beneficiary build a sustainable income-generating activity over three years and eventually reach an annual income of Rs 1 lakh.

Under MMUA Phase 1, the government provides Rs 10,000 as direct seed capital transferred to the SHG member's Aadhaar-linked bank account through DBT, with no repayment required. This amount is intended to help the beneficiary start or formalise an income-generating activity such as tailoring, poultry rearing, goat rearing, petty trade, vegetable cultivation, or handicraft production.

In Phase 2, a financial assistance package of Rs 25,000 is released to beneficiaries who have productively used the Phase 1 seed capital and whose business activity is showing measurable progress. Of this Rs 25,000, half (Rs 12,500) is a government grant that does not need to be repaid, while the remaining Rs 12,500 is a subsidised loan amount that must be returned to the bank.

Phase 3 provides a further Rs 50,000 for business expansion to beneficiaries who have productively used the Phase 2 amount, subject to field verification by ASRLM staff confirming the income activity is growing towards the Rs 1 lakh annual target. A beneficiary who successfully completes all three phases receives a total of up to Rs 85,000 in financial support from MMUA across three years.

extra_sections.title: Why Checking the SHG List Matters
extra_sections.content:
The nrlm.gov.in list is the official record of SHGs registered under ASRLM. If your group is on it, you are in line for MMUA seed money and Lakhpati Baideo support.

If your group is not listed, go to your block ASRLM office and get it registered, or you miss out on the grants.

extra_sections.heading: What the Rs 25,000 Phase 2 Includes
content: The Assam government allocated Rs 3,038 crore in the state budget for FY 2025-26 to implement MMUA at scale, with direct disbursements beginning from April 1, 2025. By the time the budget was presented, application forms had already been distributed to nearly 40 lakh women across all 35 districts through the ASRLM SHG network.

To be eligible for MMUA, the applicant must be an active and current member of an SHG registered with ASRLM, must have an Aadhaar-linked bank account for DBT receipt, and must have no pending loan defaults with her SHG or any bank. Women from general and OBC categories must not have more than three children, while women from SC, ST, Tea Tribe, Moran, or Matok communities may have up to four.

extra_sections.heading: What the Rs 25,000 Phase 2 Includes (more)
content: An additional MMUA condition is that all school-going-age girls in the applicant's household must be enrolled in school, or if not enrolled, the applicant must sign a written commitment to enrol them within the academic year. This condition reflects MMUA's broader objective of linking women's economic empowerment directly with investment in the education of the next generation in the household.

The Lakhpati Baideo scheme is a closely related Assam government initiative that aims to help existing SHG women achieve an annual income of Rs 1 lakh or more, with 'Baideo' meaning elder sister in Assamese and 'Lakhpati' meaning one who earns a lakh. The scheme provides a direct grant of Rs 35,000 to eligible ASRLM SHG members to invest in livelihood activities capable of generating this target income.

extra_sections.title: Phase 2 Is Part Grant, Part Loan
extra_sections.content:
The Phase 2 amount of Rs 25,000 is split. Rs 12,500 is a government grant that you do not repay, and Rs 12,500 is a subsidized bank loan that you do.

So it is not all free money. The Phase 1 Rs 10,000 seed capital, by contrast, is a direct grant.

extra_sections.heading: Lakhpati Baideo Is the Same Drive
content: Lakhpati Baideo targets 40 lakh women across 35 districts of Assam and works hand-in-hand with MMUA, with both programmes using the ASRLM SHG network as the primary delivery channel for reaching rural women. Women who are on the NRLM list and have achieved a satisfactory grading level in their SHG are prioritised for Lakhpati Baideo enrollment, making NRLM list verification especially important.

The NRLM framework connects SHGs in Assam to formal banking credit through the bank linkage programme, under which well-graded SHGs receive loans of two to four times their cumulative savings from public sector banks and regional rural banks at concessional interest rates. This bank credit can be used for individual member loans to cover emergencies or investments, or for group-level income-generating activities.

Tea garden workers and tribal women in Assam's hill districts are priority groups for ASRLM SHG formation. Many tea garden communities have historically been excluded from formal banking and government welfare infrastructure, and ASRLM works specifically in these areas to ensure women can access the same NRLM list registration and scheme benefits available to women in mainstream rural districts.

Women who want to join or form an SHG can approach the local Panchayat Secretary, ASRLM Community Resource Person, or Block Programme Manager, as a new group requires at least 10 willing women who agree to meet regularly, save together, and maintain basic records. ASRLM staff provide initial training on the Panchasutra principles of regular meetings, savings, lending, record-keeping, and repayment.

extra_sections.title: Women Targeted by Lakhpati Baideo
extra_sections.desc:
Lakhpati Baideo and MMUA are the same scheme under different names. The goal is to help 40 lakh SHG women in Assam earn at least Rs 1 lakh a year.

It works through the same ASRLM structure and the same nrlm.gov.in list, so checking your name covers both.

extra_sections.heading: How to Check the SHG List
content: Once an SHG is formed and passes its first grading assessment, the Block Programme Manager uploads its details to the NRLM MIS and the group appears on nrlm.gov.in, enabling members to check the list, apply for MMUA, and initiate bank linkage. The time from group formation to full NRLM registration is typically a few months, depending on how quickly the block office processes and uploads the documentation.

Errors in the NRLM list, such as wrong names, missing members, or incorrect bank account details, can be corrected by submitting a written request to the Block Programme Manager with supporting documents including Aadhaar cards, passbooks, and group meeting registers. Corrections flow upward from block to district to state before appearing on the portal, so early reporting of errors is essential.

ASRLM also manages the Assam component of the NRLM's skill development programme, which connects SHG members' household members to vocational training and employment placement. Women on the SHG list can nominate eligible family members for programmes covering trades such as garment manufacturing, healthcare assistance, hospitality, and information technology.

Members who are on the NRLM list also become eligible for the Community Investment Fund (CIF) that ASRLM disburses to mature SHGs. This fund provides additional capital to SHG groups for on-lending to members at reasonable rates, building a sustainable micro-credit ecosystem that reduces dependence on informal money lending.

extra_sections.heading: Eligibility and Conditions for MMUA
content: The Orunodoi scheme in Assam provides a monthly cash transfer of Rs 1,250 to economically weaker households, many of which include the same women who are SHG members. Women in Assam who are on the NRLM SHG list and also enrolled in Orunodoi benefit from two complementary income support streams, and readers can find the status check process in the orunodoi-assam-beneficiary-list article on Knowledge Kendra.

SHG savings and bank credit are separate from government scheme grants like MMUA, and even without scheme money a well-functioning SHG builds collective capital that members can borrow for health emergencies, school fees, or small investments at far lower cost than informal credit. The NRLM list registration is the gateway to both the formal credit system and the full government scheme pipeline that MMUA and Lakhpati Baideo represent.

extra_sections.heading: If Your Name Is Not on the List
content: SHG members in Assam who have accessed MMUA Phase 1 seed capital and used it to start a livelihood activity are encouraged to maintain a simple income and expenditure register to demonstrate productive use when ASRLM staff visit for Phase 2 verification. Keeping records of sales, purchases, savings, and expenses makes the transition from one MMUA phase to the next much smoother and faster.

The government of Assam has also linked SHG data with other welfare databases so that eligible SHG women can be proactively identified for other schemes without needing to submit fresh applications every time. Women who are on the NRLM list in Assam may receive notifications or automatic enrollment consideration for new state welfare initiatives as the government rolls them out through the ASRLM network.

extra_sections.heading: If Your Name Is Not on the List (more)
content: The MMUA scheme places particular emphasis on women from lower-income rural households who are engaged in traditional occupations like weaving, bamboo craft, food processing, and fisheries, which are common livelihoods in Assam's river island and flood-prone areas. Seed capital from MMUA Phase 1 helps these women formalise their craft as a registered income source and access raw material markets more systematically.

Citizens who are unsure whether their SHG is registered under ASRLM specifically or under a different state agency can confirm this by checking whether the group appears on nrlm.gov.in under the Assam state filter. Only ASRLM-registered SHGs appear in the NRLM database for Assam, so a successful search confirms the group is in the correct programme and eligible for MMUA and related benefits.

extra_sections.text: Checking your name on nrlm.gov.in is the first step every woman in an Assam SHG should take. If your group is registered, you are in line for MMUA seed money and Lakhpati Baideo support. If it is not, go to your block ASRLM office today and make sure your group gets on the list.

extra_sections.heading: Eligibility and Conditions for MMUA (more)
content: The ASRLM state office in Guwahati maintains a public portal at asrlms.assam.gov.in with information about district-level offices, Block Programme Manager contacts, and ongoing scheme announcements for active SHG members across all 35 districts of Assam. Any woman who cannot resolve an NRLM list query at the block level can escalate directly to the district ASRLM office with her original documents.

Assam's SHG movement has grown significantly since ASRLM began intensive mobilisation, with lakhs of groups now registered across both plains and hill districts. The NRLM list at nrlm.gov.in reflects this growth and continues to be updated as new groups form, existing groups graduate to higher grading levels, and beneficiary information is corrected through the regular verification drives conducted by ASRLM field staff.

extra_sections.heading: How to Join or Form an SHG
content: Any woman in Assam who does not currently belong to an SHG but wants to access the benefits of MMUA, Lakhpati Baideo, or NRLM bank linkage should begin the process immediately by contacting her gram panchayat or the nearest ASRLM block office. The cost of joining or forming an SHG is zero, as all mobilisation and training support from ASRLM is provided free to rural women across the state.

faqs.question: How do I check the SHG list for Assam online?
faqs.answer:
Go to nrlm.gov.in, find the Reports or SHG List section, and select Assam as your state. Then choose your district, block, gram panchayat, and village.

All registered SHGs in your village will appear, and clicking your group name shows the full member list.

faqs.question: What is the nrlm.gov.in SHG list?
faqs.answer:
The nrlm.gov.in SHG list is the national database of all self-help groups registered under the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM) in India. For Assam, it includes all SHGs enrolled through ASRLM.

It shows each group's name, ID, member names, panchayat, block, and linked bank account details.

faqs.question: What is ASRLM?
faqs.answer:
ASRLM is the Assam State Rural Livelihoods Mission, the state government body responsible for implementing the NRLM in all 35 districts of Assam. ASRLM organises women into self-help groups, trains them, links them to banks, and connects them to schemes like MMUA and Lakhpati Baideo.

Its website is asrlms.assam.gov.in.

faqs.question: What benefits do Assam SHG members get under MMUA?
faqs.answer: Under the Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyamita Abhiyan (MMUA), active SHG members in Assam get Rs 10,000 seed capital in Phase 1, Rs 25,000 (half grant, half loan) in Phase 2, and Rs 50,000 in Phase 3 for business expansion. Total potential support is Rs 85,000 per beneficiary across three years.

faqs.question: What is the MMUA Phase 1 amount and how is it given?
faqs.answer:
MMUA Phase 1 provides Rs 10,000 as seed capital to help an SHG member start or grow an income-generating activity. The amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account via DBT.

It does not need to be repaid. Disbursements started from April 1, 2025.

faqs.question: What is the Lakhpati Baideo scheme in Assam?
faqs.answer:
Lakhpati Baideo is an Assam government scheme that gives a Rs 35,000 grant to SHG women with the goal of helping each beneficiary reach an annual income of Rs 1 lakh. The scheme targets 40 lakh women across 35 districts of Assam through the ASRLM SHG network.

'Baideo' means elder sister in Assamese.

faqs.question: How much does a woman get under Lakhpati Baideo?
faqs.answer:
Under the Lakhpati Baideo scheme, eligible SHG women receive a grant of Rs 35,000 to invest in their livelihood activity. The scheme is designed to help women whose annual income is on the path to crossing Rs 1 lakh per year.

Both MMUA and Lakhpati Baideo work through the ASRLM SHG network.

faqs.question: How do I join an SHG in Assam?
faqs.answer:
To join or form an SHG in Assam, contact your local gram panchayat, the ASRLM Community Resource Person, or the Block Programme Manager at your block ASRLM office. A new group needs at least 10 willing women who agree to save together, meet regularly, and maintain basic records.

ASRLM staff provide initial training free of charge.

faqs.question: My name is not on the SHG list at nrlm.gov.in. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If your name is missing from the SHG list despite being an active member, contact your Block Programme Manager or ASRLM Community Resource Person immediately with your Aadhaar card, passbook, and group meeting register. They will initiate a correction request to update the NRLM MIS.

Do not wait, as missing enrollment blocks access to MMUA and other scheme benefits.

faqs.question: Can I download the Assam SHG list as a PDF?
faqs.answer:
Yes. After navigating to your village's SHG list on nrlm.gov.in, use your browser's print or save function to save the page as a PDF.

Some report sections on the portal also have a direct download or export option. The list is freely available to all citizens without any fee.

faqs.question: What documents are needed to register a new SHG with ASRLM?
faqs.answer: A new SHG should submit a group resolution, a list of members with their Aadhaar details, a group savings passbook, a meeting register showing at least two to three regular meetings, and a bank account opening letter from a local bank. The Block Programme Manager verifies the documents and then uploads the group to the NRLM MIS.

faqs.question: Does checking the SHG list cost any money?
faqs.answer:
No. The SHG list on nrlm.gov.in is completely free to access. No login, fee, or registration is required to search by state, district, block, panchayat, and village.

Any website or service asking you to pay to check the SHG list is not official and should be avoided.
